name: Update a Ticket
description: Update status, priority, subject, description, agent, group, etc.  [See the documentation](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#update_ticket).

configurable_props.name: ticketId
configurable_props.label: Ticket ID
configurable_props.description: Select a ticket or provide a ticket ID

configurable_props.name: group_id
configurable_props.label: Group
configurable_props.description: Select a group to assign the ticket to.

configurable_props.name: responder_id
configurable_props.label: Agent
configurable_props.description: Select an agent to assign the ticket to

configurable_props.name: email
configurable_props.label: Requester Email (replaces requester)
configurable_props.description: Updates the requester. If no contact with this email exists, a new one will be created and assigned to the ticket.

configurable_props.name: phone
configurable_props.label: Requester Phone (replaces requester)
configurable_props.description: If no contact with this phone number exists, a new one will be created. If used without email, 'name' is required.

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Requester Name (required with phone if no email)
configurable_props.description: Used when creating a contact with phone but no email.

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: Type of ticket (must match one of the allowed values)

configurable_props.name: custom_fields
configurable_props.label: Custom Fields
configurable_props.description: Custom fields as key-value pairs (make sure types match your config)
